ad_info.reference_style: Clean cream-background transformation timeline ad: 2x2 grid of day-by-day progress panels with a semi-illustrated model, product at bottom left and gold offer plaque at bottom right
ad_info.ad_format: Single Image Ad (2x2 progress timeline grid)

global_identity.color_palette: Warm cream background #FBF3DC; lemon yellow #F2DC4A (product label, accents); metallic gold #C9A441 with lighter gold highlight #E6CF7A (day labels, offer plaque); near-black #111111 (headline and offer text); amber brown #8A4B14 (bottle glass); soft white #FFFFFF for panel fills and highlights.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bright beauty-supplement ad with a soft semi-illustrated realistic rendering of the model (smooth painterly digital illustration with realistic proportions and soft shading), on a light cream canvas with a tidy grid of progress panels.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Light, warm, feminine, optimistic and trustworthy; soft diffused daylight, no harsh shadows.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded-corner rectangular panels with a hairline pale-gold border, generous cream margins, a brushed metallic gold offer plaque with a thin inner border and rounded corners, a delicate pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing behind the product, soft contact shadows under the product.
global_identity.text_typography: Typography of the reference: headline in a geometric sans-serif, extra-bold, all uppercase, solid near-black, centered, two lines, tight leading (Montserrat ExtraBold / Gotham Black style). Panel labels in the same geometric sans, bold, uppercase, metallic gold, small. Offer plaque: first line bold uppercase sans in black; middle line much larger, heavy condensed uppercase sans in black; third line regular-weight uppercase sans with wide letter spacing in black. No outlines, no shadows, no gradients on the text.

creative_objective: Sell the feeling behind the same 21-day promise (loving her silhouette again), prove it with four day-by-day panels of a mature, confident woman in a fitted dress on a pool terrace at golden hour, then close with the product and the user's exact bundle offer, keeping the exact structure of the reference.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The two-line black headline at the top. 2) The 2x2 grid of progress panels, read left to right and top to bottom, with the last panel showing the fullest result and the happiest expression. 3) The gold offer plaque at bottom right and the product at bottom left.
art_direction.composition_style: Symmetrical, centered, grid-based layout on a flat cream canvas. Three horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: headline band, 2x2 panel grid, bottom band with product (left) and offer plaque (right).
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Even cream margins around the canvas, equal narrow gutters between the four panels, panels of identical size, headline centered with breathing room above the grid, bottom band split roughly 45% product / 55% plaque.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft warm golden-hour glow inside the panels, kept pale and low-contrast; flat cream background with a faint paper warmth, gentle soft shading on the model, subtle brushed-metal sheen on the gold plaque, soft contact shadow under the bottle and box.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Flat warm cream canvas. Top band: a centered two-line headline in extra-bold black uppercase sans-serif spanning most of the width. Middle band (largest): a 2x2 grid of four equal rounded-corner panels with hairline pale-gold borders and a slightly lighter cream fill; each panel has a small bold gold uppercase day label in its top-left corner and shows the same woman from a rear three-quarter view, head to mid-thigh, looking back over her shoulder, with her curves visibly fuller from one panel to the next. Bottom band: at bottom left, a tall yellow product carton with the amber dropper bottle standing in front of it, slightly to its right, with a delicate pale-gold botanical sprig drawn behind them; at bottom right, a horizontal brushed-gold rounded plaque with a thin inner border holding three centered lines of black offer text. The brand wordmark that sat under the plaque in the reference is removed and left as plain cream background.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 static ad on a flat warm cream background (#FBF3DC), organized in three horizontal bands stacked top to bottom. TOP BAND: a centered two-line headline in extra-bold uppercase geometric sans-serif, solid near-black, spanning most of the width. MIDDLE BAND (the largest area): a 2x2 grid of four identical rounded-corner rectangular panels with hairline pale-gold borders, equal narrow gutters and even cream margins. Each panel has a small bold metallic-gold uppercase day label in its top-left corner. Every panel shows THE SAME woman in the same pose and framing: a Latina woman around 42 years old with light sun-kissed tan skin and straight chestnut-brown hair cut in a short sleek bob that ends at the jawline, wearing a short, fitted, sand-beige sleeveless bodycon dress with a modest back, seen from a rear three-quarter view, framed from head to mid-thigh at waist height, standing upright and looking back over her left shoulder with a calm, confident, self-assured smile; she looks naturally her age, elegant and radiant. Inside each panel, behind her, a softly rendered, pale and low-contrast terrace with a swimming pool at sunset: a hint of light stone floor, a soft strip of turquoise pool water and a warm peach-gold sky, all washed out and hazy so the panels stay light and airy and the day labels stay readable. From the first panel to the fourth, her hips and glutes look gradually fuller and rounder under the dress in a natural, believable, healthy progression (first panel: slimmer and flatter; fourth panel: clearly fuller curves); her face, hair, dress, pose and the terrace stay identical in all four. Rendering style of the woman and terrace: a soft semi-illustrated realistic look, a smooth painterly digital illustration with realistic proportions and gentle shading; tasteful, fully clothed, wellness tone. BOTTOM BAND, LEFT: the product, using the attached product image as the only source of truth: a 60 ml amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders, a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper, with a wraparound label that fades from bright lemon yellow at the top to white at the bottom, showing the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small line of text and five small circular ingredient badges. Do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle or its label. Behind the bottle and slightly to its left stands its tall rectangular lemon-yellow carton, slightly taller than the bottle, with the lowercase wordmark 'amua' at the top and 'VITALDROPS' in white uppercase running vertically along its front face. A delicate pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing sits behind and to the right of the product; soft contact shadow underneath. Do not include the round yellow '60 ml' sticker from the product photo. BOTTOM BAND, RIGHT: a horizontal brushed metallic gold plaque with rounded corners and a thin inner border, holding three centered lines of black text: a bold uppercase first line, a much larger heavy condensed uppercase middle line, and a lighter wide-spaced uppercase third line. The area under the plaque is plain cream background with no logo and no text. No other elements.

final_generation_exclusions: Do not use a young woman with an afro puff, a sports bra or leggings: use the woman, hair and dress described in this prompt.
Do not add a standalone brand logo or wordmark under the plaque or anywhere outside the product packaging.
Do not include the round yellow '60 ml' sticker from the product photo.
No ingredient illustrations, icons or ingredient lists outside the product label.
No swimsuit, no bikini, no nudity, no lingerie, no exaggerated or unrealistic body proportions.
No other people, no drinks, no sunglasses, no hearts or sparkles.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
